nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: Marshal Reyes said — and I memorised it — 'the boy's signals are the strangest code I have never once broken'. UNBREAKABLE, Cole. My calls are officially UNBREAKABLE.

choices.text: That is one reading of it.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: It's the CORRECT reading. She's a marshal. Readings are her whole job.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: I'm teaching a class. Tuesdays. Preacher already signed up and he can't whistle AT ALL.
